column1: TABLE RoommateStatus-main-checklists-v2 - household checklist parent records plus independently mutable checklist-item child rows. Parent ids remain the feed module id; item ids use checklist-item#<parentId>#<itemId>, which queries one checklist's items inside its group partition. itemsStorage is rows for current parents; itemRowsMigratedAt appears only on parents converted from the former embedded items list. Archived metadata is set only while archived. Keyed (groupId HASH, id RANGE): the group is the partition, so no row can be addressed from another household.
